title: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war
caption:
🌍 BREAKING: Russia says it is ready to resume talks with Ukraine and US to end war

The announcement came after Russian President Vladimir Putin met US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff in St Petersburg.
